name: fresh-clone-monorepo
description: Public known-answer fixture for map/fresh-clone.mjs workspace support: an npm-workspaces shell exactly like a real monorepo's root — no scripts, no dependencies, no lockfile of its own. Before workspace support the runner read this as six not-declared steps, exit 0, while apps/bad's real failure never surfaced. apps/good passes; apps/bad fails.
